entities.name: Bowing & Curtseying as Social Protocol
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: European court etiquette reached extreme elaboration — the depth of a bow or curtsy communicated exact social rank. Louis XIV's Versailles had rules for every gesture. Japanese bowing has 3 levels (15°, 30°, 45°). These customs encoded social hierarchy into physical movement.
